changelog:
The option count now reads out of the whole: the settings hub states "N of 202 on" instead of just a total, and every named area states its own "N of M".
The count row and its number are drawn in the theme accent colour, so the state stands out from the rows below it without becoming a status block.
Turning everything off keeps the exact denominator ("None of 202 on"), and the per-area short counts disappear as before while an area is completely off.
message: Dev build v857 - Option counts read out of the whole, in the accent colour
